company: Johnny Cash's 1970 Rolls-Royce Silver Shadow (black, gift from ABC Television)
product: Pawn Stars Season 8 clip 'BIG MONEY for ONE-OF-A-KIND Johnny Cash 1970 Rolls Royce' (YouTube id 9OkI1EMbq8U). Owner Steve brought Cash's drummer W.S. Holland for provenance. Ask $350,000; expert Steve Ray Anastos valued it around $50,000; Rick offered $50,000; owner would not go under $200,000; no deal, owner said he would take it to auction.

facts.fact: ABC Television bought the car as a gift to Johnny Cash after the success of The Johnny Cash Show in 1969.
W.S. Holland was Johnny Cash's drummer; Cash called him in 1960 for two weeks and it lasted almost 40 years.
Expert: engine never out of the car, a survivor, all original leather, 31,000 original miles.
Expert: last year another 1970 Rolls-Royce said to be owned by Johnny Cash sold at auction for $49,500, so he put this one around $50,000.
W.S. Holland: that car was a maroon, longer limousine; Johnny Cash never owned it and never saw it.
Rick: if you say $50,000 I'll buy it. Owner: can't take less than $200,000. No deal; owner plans to take it to auction.
After the show the car sold at Barrett-Jackson Las Vegas (September 25-27, 2014) for $88,000.
Pre-sale article: on a 2013 Pawn Stars episode it was offered at $350,000 and passed on; later reduced to $150,000 and still unsold; owned by Cash until about 1985.
